log_dir.description: Directory to store agent log files.

log_file.description: Name of the agent log file.

ovs_bridge.description: Name of the Open vSwitch integration bridge used for VM traffic.

integration_bridge.description: Integration bridge for local VM-to-VM and VM-to-gateway traffic.

enable_tunneling.description: Enable overlay network tunneling (e.g., Geneve, VXLAN).

tunnel_type.description: Tunnel type to use (geneve, vxlan, or gre).

local_ip.description: Local IP address on the hypervisor used as tunnel endpoint (required if tunneling enabled).

vtep_udp_checksum.description: Enable UDP checksum for VXLAN traffic (improves reliability, may impact performance).

vtep_flow_offload.description: Enable hardware offload for VXLAN flow processing (if supported).

tunnel_mtu.description: Maximum transmission unit (MTU) for tunnel interfaces. Lower than physical interface MTU to avoid fragmentation.

ovn_nb_db.description: OVN Northbound database connection string(s) (comma-separated for HA).

ovn_sb_db.description: OVN Southbound database connection string(s) (comma-separated for HA).

enable_chassis_as_edge.description: Treat each chassis (compute node) as a distributed edge router.

enable_distributed_floating_ip.description: Enable distributed routing for floating IPs (requires L3 agent disabled).

enable_ha_for_floating_ips.description: Enable high availability (HA) for floating IPs (requires distributed routing).

enable_snat.description: Enable SNAT (source NAT) on chassis for external network traffic.

snat_gateway_port.description: Gateway port name or UUID used for SNAT (optional; auto-selected if not set).

enable_fip_nat.description: Enable NAT rules for floating IPs (required unless using distributed SNAT).

max_l3_router_ports.description: Maximum number of L3 router ports (interfaces) per chassis.

max_floating_ips_per_router.description: Maximum number of floating IPs per router.

enable_metadata.description: Enable metadata service proxy (requires Neutron metadata agent disabled).

tenant_network_type.description: Tenant network type (geneve, vxlan, vlan, flat) used for metadata traffic.

metadata_proxy_secret.description: Shared secret between Neutron server and agents for metadata proxy authentication.

metadata_network.description: Name or ID of the metadata network used by the agent.

ovn_l3_scheduler.description: L3 scheduler algorithm (leastloaded, mostloaded, random) to assign routers to chassis.

enable_qos_ext_driver.description: Enable QoS (Quality of Service) extension driver for rate limiting and bandwidth allocation.

enable_sg_ext_driver.description: Enable security group extension driver for firewall rules.

audit_log.description: Enable OVN audit logging (records all DB changes for debugging/forensics).

polling_interval.description: Interval (seconds) between OVSDB polling for changes.

ovsdb_connection_max_retries.description: Maximum number of OVSDB connection retries on failure.

ovsdb_transaction_concurrency.description: Maximum number of concurrent OVSDB transactions.

min_workers.description: Minimum number of worker threads for async event processing.

max_workers.description: Maximum number of worker threads for async event processing.

enable_security_group.description: Enable Neutron security groups (requires OpenStack security group API enabled).

log_security_group_events.description: Log security group rule updates and port updates.

debug_security_group_events.description: Enable debug logging for security group events (very verbose).

firewall_driver.description: Firewall driver (ovn, iptables_hybrid, none). 'ovn' uses OVN-native ACLs.

enable_ipset.description: Use ipset for efficient SG member tracking (requires ipset kernel module).

enable_flood_rules.description: Drop packets early if too many SG rules are added (prevents OVS rule overflow).

enable_dhcp_options.description: Enable OVN to inject DHCP options via DHCP options table (requires OVN >= 20.06).

enable_dhcpv6_stateless.description: Enable stateless DHCPv6 (RA + DHCP for metadata, DNS, etc).

type_drivers.description: List of supported network type drivers (must include at least one).

tenant_network_types.description: Tenant network types to allocate by default (subset of type_drivers).

mechanism_drivers.description: Mechanism drivers to integrate with OVS/OVN.

extension_drivers.description: Extension drivers enabled on this agent (e.g., for port security, QoS, DNS).

database_connection.description: Optional separate database connection string for agent metadata (rarely needed).

database_max_retries.description: Maximum number of retries for database connection.
